biggest_catch: Harvard's Neuromotor Control Lab officially pays $20 per hour for 1-3 hour experiments — concrete rate and duration — but its volunteering page states no payment timing or method, so it cannot be framed as paying the same day.
catches: No official payout timing or payment method stated.
Experiments require in-person attendance at 33 Oxford St., Cambridge, MA.
COVID-era screening call required 24 hours before the session.
Arm-movement experiments; participants sit alone in the experiment room.

c1.evidence: Official lab volunteering page confirms a paid program: 'Volunteers are paid $20 per hour. Experiments are non-invasive and generally last 1-3 hours.' (seas.harvard.edu/motorlab/volunteering.html)

c2.evidence: Concrete rate: $20 per hour for 1-3 hour experiments ($20-$60 per session).

c3.evidence: No payout-timing commitment in official terms.

c4.evidence: No upfront fee; volunteers are paid.

eligibility: Must be symptom-free; complete a pre-visit screening call 24 hours prior; attend in person in Cambridge, MA
maximize: Do not count on same-day cash — no official pay date exists. Only join an experiment whose scheduling email states the payment method and timing in writing.
